profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record, tagged EdgeConneX Portland, sits in Hillsboro, Oregon, within EdgeConneX Portland-area campus, which per the operator own market page and a July 2020 press release consists of up to three named buildings. POR01 is described as 39,400 total square feet with 18,700 square feet of raised floor space, POR02 as 16,850 total square feet with an initial 3 megawatts of N+1 critical capacity expandable to 6 megawatts, and POR03 as a planned facility of up to 21 megawatts that the 2020 release stated would bring the full campus to more than 30 megawatts combined. This OSM record generic Portland naming, without a POR-series suffix, made it impossible to confirm this session which specific one of those three buildings, if any single one, it corresponds to, so no building-specific capacity or square footage figure is asserted here, only the campus-level context. No year-opened date or named anchor tenant is disclosed for any of the three Portland buildings on EdgeConneX own site, only network and cloud-interconnection partners such as Arelion, Cogent, Lumen, Verizon, Megaport, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. EdgeConneX is a US-based edge and build-to-suit data center operator founded in 2009 and headquartered in Herndon, Virginia, with regional headquarters in Amsterdam and Singapore, acquired by EQT Infrastructure in 2020 with Sixth Street also holding a board seat. EdgeConneX describes its footprint today as more than 90 data centers across more than 60 markets in over 20 countries on four continents, and it operates a joint venture called AdaniConneX in India alongside a strategic investment in the China-based operator Chayora. EdgeConneX naming convention across its US markets typically pairs an airport-code-style market abbreviation, such as POR for Portland, CHI for Chicago, DET for Detroit, and SDG for San Diego, with a sequential building number, a shorthand common across the colocation and edge-computing industry for quickly identifying a facility market and build order within that market.

reading.body:
EdgeConneX operates three separate facilities in the Portland market under a single ambiguous registry entry, with disclosed capacities ranging from 18,700 square feet of raised floor space to planned power draws up to 21 MW, but this record cannot be matched to a specific building.

The three Portland buildings, identified by the operator as POR01, POR02, and POR03, carry different published specifications. POR02 is planned for 3 MW initially, scaling to 6 MW with redundancy across two data halls. POR03 is planned for up to 21 MW. No power figure is published for POR01, which has 18,700 square feet of raised floor. The operator's own location page does not provide street addresses for any of the three facilities, and their coordinates in this record do not resolve to a specific building among them.

All three facilities hold certifications for SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and ISO 27001 compliance at the market level. The operator, founded in 2009 and acquired by EQT Infrastructure in 2020, operates over 90 data centers globally. This registry cannot assign power or square footage figures to this entry without confirming which Portland building it represents, so none are attributed here. The ambiguity prevents tracking whether this site is built, planned, or represents capacity in flux.
